provenance.combat: Visual only; runtime baseline combat_manifest remains authoritative.
provenance.alpha_processing: tools/art/remove_generated_magenta.py without --rust-contour; isolated one-pixel matte residue at blank sheet corners was cleared.
provenance.refinement: 2026-09-07: targeted image_gen revisions for walk, sweep and air_kick; no regeneration of already satisfactory actions. Versioned originals and rejected sources preserved.

idle.notes: Three selected poses from four generated. Uniform body scale; deep squat pose omitted. Feet at same source ground. Static review completed; final GPU motion review pending.

walk.notes: New v5 four distinct guarded shuffle phases: front contact/load, rear foot closes, front foot advances. 60ms each; original total240ms. Uniform264/566 scale from standing silhouette.

crouch.notes: Three progressively folded poses. Scale comes from first upright body, not the shrinking crouch bounds. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

jump.notes: Takeoff then rise/fall. Rise/fall pivots compensate the52px belt displacement in the source. Their heads differ by7sourcepixels after registration; no artificial whole-body jump offset is baked into the frame. Physics supplies the arc. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

block.notes: Standing guard, crossed-arm absorption and held guard, grounded at the soles. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

crouch_block.notes: Deep crouching guard v2 selected. Standing-height reference444 is inherited from the crouch sheet whose head size matches this sheet. v1 was a shallow squat and rejected. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

hit.notes: Recoil and pain pose, then exhausted recovery. First pose stretches and tilts; normalize using the final upright body, not the widest recoil bounds. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

punch_light.notes: v4 compact jab selected. v1 reached too far, v2 lost the punch, v3 remained too long. Knuckles approach the far edge of the existing short hitbox; no hitbox changed. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

punch_heavy.notes: Heavy weight shift and full extension; source cells use wider explicit bounds so the active fist is never clipped. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

kick.notes: Knee chamber, compact low kick, recovery. The planted foot stays at the ground anchor. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

sweep.notes: New v5 hand-braced low sweep; cream bare foot and blue forearm identity preserved. Active sole overlaps existing elevated sweep box without gameplay changes. Original166/150/217ms.

overhead.notes: v2 overhead selected: startup fist above head descends into forward contact. v1 was too low/short; v3 lowered the knuckles below the box. v2 lower knuckles overlap the active box while upper glove extends above it. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

anti_air.notes: Uniform scale0.5 based on normal body/head size, not raised-fist alpha height. Rising pose stretches body slightly; the overhead fist matches the existing high box. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

air_punch.notes: v2 raises contact from the original below-belt diving punch. Pivots register torso/head to a stable virtual floor across the three source drawings; physics supplies air displacement. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

air_kick.notes: New v2 lowers the contact foot into existing air-kick box. Stable virtual-ground pivot follows head/belt; original83/133/117ms unchanged.

throw.notes: Open-handed preparation, compact grip and recovery. First crop widened to preserve every finger; grip contact remains near the short throw range. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

special.notes: v2 compact palm emission chosen to meet the existing origin97.92px forward/123.84px up from frame0. Projectile remains the separate baseline asset; no baked projectile or candidate combat metadata. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

spawn.notes: Belt adjustment, courteous bow and ready guard. Original fixed identity remains visible throughout the entrance. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

victory.notes: Relax, celebrate and hold a thumbs-up. Scale from upright body, with no shrink for the lifted arm. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.

defeat.notes: Disappointment, kneel and defeated seated hold; all are grounded. Scale is inherited from first standing body, not kneeling height. Explicit visual review for packing; final-art approval remains pending.
